Bill.BriefDescription: Filing a will under seal before the testator's death.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to filing a will under seal before the testator'sdeath; and adding a new section to chapter 11.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 11.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person who has custody or control of any original will and whohas not received knowledge of the death of the testator may deliver thewill for filing under seal to any court having jurisdiction. Thetestator may withdraw the original will so filed upon properidentification. Any other person, including an attorney in fact orguardian of the testator, may withdraw the original will so filed onlyupon court order after showing of good cause. Upon request andpresentation of a certified copy of the testator's death certificate,the clerk shall unseal the file. This section does not preclude filinga will not under seal and does not alter any duty of a person havingknowledge of the testator's death to file the will.
